posts.text: Shipped the multi-agent SQL assistant to production this week — business users now query enterprise data in plain English instead of writing SQL. Early numbers suggest it's freeing up over 3 FTEs of manual reporting time.
Prompt engineering is 20% writing the prompt and 80% designing the feedback loop around it. A few lessons from building agent orchestration for analytics teams.
Automated our entire LinkedIn content pipeline end-to-end with Make.com and the Claude API — from ideation to publishing, zero manual steps. Happy to share how it's wired up.
